examNameMr: सहायक प्राध्यापक (इंग्रजी), महाराष्ट्र अभियांत्रिकी शिक्षक सेवा, गट-अ उच्च आणि तंत्रशिक्षण विभाग
examPattern: Written Examination / Screening Test followed by Document Verification or Interview

units.unitTitle: English in India and Indian Literature in English
units.unitTitleMr: भारतातील इंग्रजी आणि इंग्रजीतील भारतीय साहित्य
topics: English in India: History and Evolution, Development of English Education in India, English in Post-Independence India, English in Contemporary India, Creative Writing in India, Indian Knowledge System and Ancient Indian Literature

Indian Literature in English: Poetry, Novel, Fiction, Short Stories, Drama, Creative Non-fiction with focus on 19th to 21st Century Literature, extending to some degree, the larger Indian Subcontinent

units.unitTitle: History of English Literature and English Literary Studies and Latin-American and European Literature in English
units.unitTitleMr: इंग्रजी साहित्याचा इतिहास आणि इंग्रजी साहित्य अभ्यास आणि लॅटिन अमेरिकन आणि युरोपियन साहित्य इंग्रजीमध्ये
topics: History of English Literature and English Literary Studies: Drama (Ancient to Medieval Drama including Greek, Roman and English Drama, Renaissance and Restoration Drama, Victorian and Modern Drama, World Drama)
Poetry (Old English and Medieval Poetry, The Renaissance and Early Modern Poetry, The Romantic Era, Modernist and Postmodernist Poetry, Contemporary and Global English Poetry)
Fiction (The Rise of English Fiction, The Victorian Novel, Modernist Fiction, Postcolonial and Global Fiction, Contemporary Multicultural Fiction)
Non-Fictional Prose (Early Beginnings- Renaissance and Reformation, The Enlightenment and Augustan Age, Romantic and Victorian, Modernist and Postcolonial, Contemporary and Global)
Latin-American and European Literature in English: Poetry, Fiction, Short Stories, Drama, Creative non-fiction with focus on 19th to 21st Century Literature
Literary Criticism: Classical Literary Criticism, Medieval and Renaissance, Neoclassical and Enlightenment, Romantic and Victorian, Modern and Contemporary Criticism
Literary Theory: Structuralism and Semiotics, Post-Structuralism and Deconstruction, Psychoanalytic and Marxist Criticism, Postmodernism and Postcolonialism, Feminism and Contemporary

Cultural Studies: Foundations and Early Influences, Emergence of Cultural Studies as a Discipline, Globalization and Cultural Hybridity, Cultural Studies in the Digital Era, Future Directions and Challenges

Translation Studies: Key Concepts in Translation, Classical and Linguistic Translation Studies, Modern Approaches in Translation Studies, Literary, Scientific and Technical Translation, Audio-Visual Translation, Ethics in Translation, Culture and Translation

units.unitTitle: Research Methodology and ICT (Information and Communication Technology)
units.unitTitleMr: संशोधन पद्धती आणि माहिती व संप्रेषण तंत्रज्ञान (ICT)
topics: Research Methodology: Definition, Purpose, and Scope of Research, Types of Research, Research Design, Methods of Data Collection, Hypothesis, Data Analysis, Report Writing, Research Ethics and Plagiarism, Research in English Language, Research in English Literature

ICT (Information and Communication Technology): Basics of ICT- Definition and importance in Education, Hardware and software essentials, Operating systems (Windows, Linux), basic computer skills, ICT Tools in Language Learning, Online Resources, ICT Pedagogy

units.unitTitle: Usage in English, Grammar, and Soft Skills
units.unitTitleMr: इंग्रजीचा वापर, व्याकरण आणि सॉफ्ट स्किल्स
topics: Usage in English: Sentence Structure, Sentence Transformation, Error Spotting and Correction, Vocabulary Usage, Functional Use of English- Conversational English, Business Communication, Academic English, English for Specific Purposes (ESP), Common Errors
Grammar: Parts of Speech, Tenses, Voice and Narration, Clauses and Phrases, Modals and Auxiliaries, Sentence Analysis

Soft Skills: Introspective, Listening and Reading, Presentation, Group Discussion, Goal Setting, Interview, Time Management, Stress Management, Anger Management, Negotiation, Conflict Resolution, Problem Solving, Leadership, Team Management
